title: Python DIO serializer emits noncanonical SCHC version option lengths
description: Final Rule/version correctness review: python/src/lichen/rpl/messages.py:183-195 rejects duplicate type 0x13 options but accepts explicit option data of length 0 or 2 and serializes malformed 1300 or 1302.... Require every supplied SCHC Rule Version option to have exactly one data byte before serialization, while preserving a valid explicit one-byte remote version for round-trip/mismatch tests and injecting current v3 only when absent. Add malformed length, duplicate, explicit mismatch, root/non-root, and vector coverage.
